content.short: NiftyGateway is an NFT marketplace and digital art online auction platform.
content.description: Founded by Duncan and Griffin Cock Foster, NiftyGateway is a digital art online auction platform where users can buy, sell, create, publish, or display NFTs. For developers, NiftyGateway enables NFT minting and wallet integration for NFT projects or games. The platform does not charge gas fees. It operates across Ethereum, Solana, Polygon, Avalanche, Base, and BNB Chain, offering broad access to NFT marketplaces and experiences in a single platform.
